title: v2.logistics.update_tracking_status
label: SHOPEE · API REFERENCE
html:
Only available for Brazil sellers. This API is only available for orders/parcels which are fulfilled by BR Seller Logistics channel (logistics_channel_id: 90021), Samsung (logistics_channel_id: 90025) and BR Instant Delivery channel (logistics_channel_id: 90026). The logistics_status will become LOGISTICS_REQUEST_CREATED after arrange shipment, and can call this API to update to: LOGISTICS_PICKUP_DONE, LOGISTICS_DELIVERY_DONE, LOGISTICS_DELIVERY_FAILED.

Request

Request Address

POST/api/v2/logistics/update_tracking_status

Base URL: https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/update_tracking_status

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredSampleDescription
order_snstringTrue201212DCXHJUIKJ<p>Shopee's unique identifier for an order.<br /></p>
tracking_numberstringFalse1234567890<p>Order tracking number, might help seller to identify his order on the tracking_URL.</p><p>Can only be sent when updating logistics_status to "logistic_pickup_done".<br /></p>
tracking_urlstringFalsehttps://tracking_url_order_201212DCXHJUIKJ<p>Website's URL for order tracking with maximum length of 2048 characters.</p><p>Can only be sent when updating logistics_status to "logistic_pickup_done".<br /></p>
logistics_statusstringTruelogistics_pickup_done<p>Order status update support:</p><p>- logistics_pickup_done</p><p>- logistics_delivery_done</p><p>- logistics_delivery_failed<br /></p>
failed_reasonstringFalsebuyer_unreachable<p>Only required when updating logistics_status to "logistics_delivery_failed". Only required for BR Instant Delivery channel (logistics_channel_id: 90026). Only accept the following values. </p><p>- buyer_unreachable</p><p>- buyer_unresponsive</p><p>- no_delivery_location_consensus</p>

}
